name: M3 heat-set insert (CNC Kitchen M3 x 5.7)
summary: Brass insert melted into a printed part. Needs a 4 mm hole at least 6.7 mm deep.
source: CNC Kitchen metric insert table: M3 x 5.7 is 5.7 mm long and 4.6 mm across the knurl, wants a 4 mm hole at least 6.7 mm deep and at least 1.6 mm of plastic around the hole. Other brands of the same nominal size differ by a few tenths, so test-fit one before printing a whole enclosure.
